scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const d=p.dirname(require.resolve('pdfjs-dist/package.json'));const c=['build/pdf.worker.min.mjs','build/pdf.worker.mjs','build/pdf.worker.min.js','build/pdf.worker.js'].map(f=>p.join(d,f)).find(f=>fs.existsSync(f));if(!c)throw new Error('pdf worker not found');fs.mkdirSync('public',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(c,'public/pdf.worker.mjs');console.log('pdf worker:',c)"
